subject: PROPERTY clause
notes: Format: PROPERTY [WITH NO {GET|SET}] [IS FINAL]; WITH and IS are not underlined (optional words), so they may be omitted. Grammar `PROPERTY (WITH? NO (GET | SET))? (IS? FINAL)?` matches it exactly. Probes with the pinned compiler at --std 2023: `PROPERTY WITH NO GET SET` -> COBOL0307 (correct: exactly one of GET/SET); `PROPERTY IS FINAL WITH NO GET` -> COBOL0307 (correct: phrase order is as printed); `PROPERTY NO SET.` (WITH omitted), `PROPERTY WITH NO SET IS FINAL`, `PROPERTY FINAL` all compile and run (probe gr_positive). The binder reads pc.NO()/GET()/SET()/FINAL() directly. cite.py --check 13.18.42.2 "PROPERTY" -> OK (General format). No test covers the FINAL phrase or the WITH-less spelling as a golden, so test-ref is empty. || Editions (adjudicator's statement, normalized to 2002,2014,2023 by registrar 14e): 2002, 2014, 2023 (the PROPERTY clause is part of the OO facility; not in 1985)
